description:
[FREE] PCLAS - Predictive Cognitive-Load Anticipation System for agent
fleets. Forecasts each agent's workload over a horizon (Holt exponential
smoothing on provided history, or deterministic synthesis), detects
overload peaks BEFORE they happen, and computes a proactive task
reassignment plan moving low-priority heavy tasks to agents with headroom.
Verdicts: STABLE (no overload), REASSIGN (plan clears all peaks),
CRITICAL (overload survives reassignment). This tool returns service info
and terms. The paid forecast endpoint is
https://agentpaystore.com/pclas/api/forecast (POST, $0.05 USDC via x402
on Base L2, HTTP 402 without X-Payment). Input: agents 1-50 (id, capacity,
load, optional history 1-24 points), optional tasks 0-200 (id, agent_id,
weight, priority 1-5), horizon 1-24, volatility 0-1.
